verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਾਚੋ ਪਾਰੋ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਮ ਖਾਇਓ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਮਾਰੇ ਨਿਹਕਲੰਕ ਹੁਇ ਕਲੰਕਨ ਮਿਟਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise kaacho paaro mahaa bikham khaio na jai maare nihakala(n)k hui kala(n)kan miTaaviee ||

en.bdb: Just as raw mercury is very harmful to eat but when treated and processed, it becomes edible and a medicine to cure many ailments.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਮਨ ਸਬਦ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਟਿ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਹੁਇ ਬਿਕਾਰਨ ਘਟਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: taise man sabadh beechaar maar haumai meT paraupakaaree hui bikaaran ghaTaaviee ||

en.bdb: So should the mind be treated with the words of wisdom of the Guru. Dispelling ego and pride, then becoming benevolent it reduces other vices. It frees the evil and vice-ridden people from evil deeds.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਧਮੁ ਅਸਾਧੁ ਹੁਇ ਮਿਲਤ ਚੂਨਾ ਜਿਉ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਰਸੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: saadh sa(n)g adham asaadh hui milat choonaa jiau ta(n)bol ras ra(n)g pragaTaaviee ||

en.bdb: When a lowly person joins the saintly congregation, he too becomes superior just as lime when joined by a betel leaf and other ingredients yield beautiful red colour.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਚੰਚਲ ਚਿਤ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਚਤੁਰ ਕੁੰਟ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਟ ਸਮਾਵਈ ॥੨੫੮॥
verses.translit_en: taise hee cha(n)chal chit bhramat chatur ku(n)T charan kamal sukh sa(n)paT samaaviee ||258||

en.bdb: So would a base and frolicsome mind wandering in four directions get absorbed in the blissful spiritual state by coming into the refuge of the holy feet of the True Guru and the blessing of the saintly assembly. (258)
